_comment: `super.method()` looks the method up on the parent prototype but calls it with the current `this`: the parent method reads the instance's field, which holds the service. Under the class rule (a service that reaches class code bails its key; class code is every class body that is not a key class, and every function nested in one) the service reaches the constructors and methods, so every method stays, including the unread one, and the bundle runs.
